verdicts.reason: A leaves the left ~20% of the strip empty, pushes the logo into the far right corner where it nearly touches the detached lime circle, and pulls the circle off the shoe so it reads as a stray dot; the NEW VIDEO badge is shrunk to an unreadable pill tacked onto the subcopy. B reads in a sensible order (logo, shoe, headline) and uses the width better, but the NEW VIDEO badge is a tiny illegible pill crammed against the top of the logo, and the lime circle is again cut off from the shoe and left floating alone at the right edge, so the original's layered hero graphic is lost in both.
